0022600114.text: The Magic (0-2) head to New York as the 13th-ranked team in the East and fourth in the Southeast, 2 games back, after losing both of their home games, while the Knicks (0-2) are 12th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, averaging 24.5 points and 33.8 minutes this season), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), and Anthony Black is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, while New York's Jose Alvarado is also day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025 in Orlando, a 132-120 Knicks win.
